additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368539-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001144] Charger offline on OCPP CRM:00642001315
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
We have checked the router configuration via SSH and found that it is configured correctly.
But we can also see that on 14th July connection lost around 25 times, which caused charger to go offline on OCPP.
On router 2(XF4) network connection is set to manual mode and the network is "Com4 Com4".
And we have changed the configuration of router1 (XF3).
Please let me know if you want to change any settings on XF4 or can we close this ticket?
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
